    # Also strip _v\d+ suffix
    base_v = re.sub(r'_v\d+$', '', eid)

    for sid in all_success:
        s_base = re.sub(r'_r\d+$', '', sid)
        s_base_v = re.sub(r'_v\d+$', '', sid)
